name: codex-project-flow
description: Install and safely upgrade a six-file schema-10 Codex workflow with one-time hub handoff, execution-task-owned acceptance and self-archival, reviewed Markdown writes, recoverable hub replacement, and transactional recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap, upgrade, and reconcile a permanent project workflow.
interface.longDescription: Adopts a permanent project hub that starts each request once, then hands the full lifecycle to one visible execution task for clarification, reviewed Markdown writes, validation, acceptance, and exact self-archival. Supports recoverable hub replacement and upgrades only the invoking task's current project from immutable baselines.
defaultPrompt: Use $bootstrap-project-flow in this saved local project to install the workflow and adopt this task as its permanent hub.
Use $upgrade-project-flow from a task inside the target project to apply a task-aware upgrade with current-project isolation and empty-snapshot fail-closed recovery.
